about: For an iPhone with an Action button, with Routine Run's In hand control on it: Settings › Action Button › Controls. Start this in the morning, and every press of the side button adds one — reps, glasses, laps, anything you would otherwise have to open the phone to write down. The number is on the run, and Keep carries it up to the routine.
name: Count it without looking

steps.about: Nothing else is on the button while this run is pinned, so it cannot go wrong in a pocket. The count is a value called count on this step: open the run to read it, change it by hand if you miscounted, and press Next when the day is done.
steps.title: Every press adds one
